data.title: Wolff makes remarkable 'AI agent' comparison after Antonelli's supreme Italian GP
data.description: Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff has compared Kimi Antonelli to an 'AI agent' following the young Italian's incredible Italian GP win from P19. Praising the Italian's development since a topsy-turvy debut season, Wolff made the comparison for a driver now 66 points at the top of the standings.
